svg.text: Token cost — Playwright MCP vs rever-browser
Same reversing task, both agent-driven. Measured with tiktoken (cl100k) on real traffic.
B · Find the signing code in a real 422 KB minified bundle
Playwright MCP has no script-body grep, so analysing JS forces the whole bundle into context.
rever returns only the slice it needs, so cost stays flat as the target grows.
